artifact_manifest.text_excerpt:
Open Brewery DB: Small Brewery Type Comparison

Filtered sample size: 8 breweries across 4 type-filtered listing pages. This report compares record completeness and directory usefulness for micro, brewpub, planning, and proprietor entries.

8sample records
4brewery types
2records per type
1bounded workflow

Method

The sample was assembled from Open Brewery DB public listing pages, using the page snippets visible in search results as the evidence source. The docs page confirms the API fields and the type vocabulary used here.

Source Purpose
https://openbrewerydb.org/documentation Field schema and brewery type definitions
https://openbrewerydb.org/breweries/United%20States?by_type=micro Micro sample records
https://www.openbrewerydb.org/breweries/United%20States/32?by_type=brewpub Brewpub sample records
https://www.openbrewerydb.org/breweries/United%20States/13?by_type=planning Planning sample records
https://openbrewerydb.org/breweries/United%20States?by_type=proprietor Proprietor sample records

Type Comparison

Type Count Observed pattern in sample Directory quality readout
micro 2 Both records show street-level addresses and conventional visitor locations. Strong directory utility; fields are complete enough for cards and maps.
brewpub 2 Both records are visitor-facing and include street addresses in the listing snippet. High usefulness for end users; good fit for static directory cards.
planning 2 Both records omit street lines in the visible listing snippet and only expose city/state/postal context. Lowest completeness in this sample; should be clearly flagged as not yet open.
proprietor 2 Both records have street addresses, but the type indicates an incubator/contract-style operation rather than a standard visitor brewery. Useful for operational coverage, but not equivalent to a public taproom listing.

Sample Records

micro

  • (405) Brewing Co - Norman, Oklahoma - 1716 Topeka St
  • 512 Brewing Co - Austin, Texas - 407 Radam Ln Ste F200

brewpub

  • One Eyed Buffalo Brewing Company LLC - Thermopolis, Wyoming - 528 Broadway St
  • One Well Brewing - Kalamazoo, Michigan - 4213 Portage St

planning

  • Unify Brewing Company - Glenwood Springs, Colorado - no street line in the snippet
  • Union House Brewing LLC - Plum City, Wisconsin - no street line in the snippet

proprietor

  • 14er Brewing Company - Denver, Colorado - 2801 Walnut St
  • 3 Sons Brewing Co. - Dania, Florida - 236 N Federal Hwy

Source-Quality Summary

  • Completeness: planning records were the least complete in the visible snippets because the street field was absent.
  • Visitor relevance: micro and brewpub entries are the strongest candidates for public directory cards.
  • Semantics: proprietor records are location-rich but should not be counted as equivalent to visitor-facing breweries.
